target.title: feat(cloud): publish content-addressed review snapshots
target.body:
## Summary

- freeze and sanitize one SQLite image before any remote mutation, then use its SHA-256 for D1 and R2 identity
- publish all nine Gitcrawl cloud-v2 datasets with rotating mutation tokens, complete coverage activation, and default reader cutover
- preserve legacy no-flag reader refresh while adding explicit `--stage-only` publication that can resume safely from immutable snapshot capabilities
- fail closed on stale or incomplete revisions, fingerprints, summaries, clusters, and PR hydration unless explicitly overridden
- strip raw JSON, patches, blobs, local source indexes, review-thread payloads, run errors/stats, and private local paths before bundle hashing
- consume the signed public Crawlkit `v0.14.0` snapshot provenance and capability API

## Validation

- `GOWORK=off go mod tidy`
- `GOWORK=off go vet ./...`
- `GOWORK=off go test -count=1 ./...`
- `GOWORK=off go test -race -count=1 ./internal/cli ./internal/store`
- `GOWORK=off go build ./...`

## Dependencies

- https://github.com/openclaw/crawl-remote/pull/36
- https://github.com/openclaw/crawlkit/releases/tag/v0.14.0
